2609.10153.title: YallaMorph: A Benchmark for Evaluating Arabic Morphological Generation in Large Language Models
2609.10153.paper_summary: Arabic morphology remains challenging for large language models, since fluent generation does not guarantee accurate morphosyntactic control. Existing Arabic evaluations mainly target downstream tasks and do not directly test controlled morphological generation from explicit lexical and feature-based input. We introduce YallaMorph, a large-scale benchmark for Arabic morphological generation covering verbs, nouns, adjectives, their cliticized forms, and invalid configurations. We evaluate multilingual and Arabic-oriented LLMs under diacritized and undiacritized settings over 600K benchmark entries. Results show that Arabic morphological generation remains difficult, especially for cliticized, unseen, and morphologically rare forms.
2609.10153.paper_summary_zh: 阿拉伯語形態學對大型語言模型仍然具有挑戰性，因為流利的生成並不保證準確的形態句法控制。現有的阿拉伯語評估主要針對下游任務，並未直接測試從明確的詞彙和基於特徵的輸入中進行的受控形態生成。我們介紹了 YallaMorph，一個涵蓋動詞、名詞、形容詞、它們的附加形式以及無效配置的大規模阿拉伯語形態生成基準。我們在600K基準條目上評估了多語言和以阿拉伯語為導向的 LLM，分別在有標記和無標記的設置下進行。結果顯示，阿拉伯語形態生成仍然困難，特別是對於附加形式、未見過的形式和形態上罕見的形式。
